_comment: Italian variety pass, archetypes over lessons 18-24 (branch feat/fr-it-variety). L18-L24 = manifest indices 18-24 per the same convention as french-variety-18-24.json (the French payload's L18-L24 name time/weather/market/health/pharmacy/emergency/invitations). Assignment D,A,B,C,D,E,F. Each lesson reorders its `steps` AND `legacyExercises` together, so step i and legacy exercise i stay the same exercise, and rebuilds nextStepId to match. Only `steps` and `legacyExercises` are named; activities/entryStepId/completionPolicy are untouched. Note: the spec's archetype rows B-F omit `review`; per the French precedent every lesson keeps it immediately before the closing `listen` step. it-market-foundation (listening family, 14 steps) is handled as its own design: intro, its five-step listening block, then the standard slots in archetype-B order. Applied by scripts/content/differentiate-first-words.py.
